Your week ahead: elections, petrol and the rand 🗓️🇿🇦

A big week for your pocket and your vote. Here's what's happening:

🗳️ Mon 2 – Tue 3 Nov: special votes for people who applied (08:00–17:00).

🇺🇸 Tue 3 Nov: US midterm elections. Americans vote for the House, a third of the Senate and 36 governors. Why it matters here: big US results can move the dollar, oil and the rand, and a weaker rand means pricier petrol and food.

🇿🇦 Wed 4 Nov: Local Government Elections, and a public holiday. You're choosing who runs your municipality: water, electricity, refuse, roads and the rates you pay.

⛽ Wed 4 Nov: new petrol and diesel prices, plus the fuel levy cut starts: R1.50 a litre off petrol and R3 off diesel until 1 December. Forecasts disagree, from a small drop to about R2 a litre up, so wait for the official price, announced just before Wednesday.

📊 Coming up: election results are due within 7 days; inflation figures on 18 Nov; the Reserve Bank's interest rate decision on 19 Nov.

Your municipal vote decides how your rates and service bills are spent. Will you be voting on Wednesday? 👇
